title: fabchem-optimizer case-run manifest
description: Machine-readable result-traceability record for one case-study run, per Overview section 3.3. Written by `make cases` into cases/<case-name>/manifest.json — never hand-edited. Locked at P0 ahead of Gate C4 (when cases first land) so the evidence pipeline is proven with a hand-written fixture before any real case exists — see tests/unit/test_case_manifest_schema.py.

config_hash.description: hash of the frozen configs/cases/<case-name>.* + cost_basis input this run was generated from

monte_carlo.description: required once a case reports TAC distribution numbers (Overview section 5.3)

kpis.description: case-specific key results (e.g. purity, recovery, tac_median, tac_ci_low/high) - shape varies by case_name and is not fixed at schema level
